dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: Mm... You've got a sense for these things, so I don't see the harm in sharing.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: I'm trying to recreate an opulent fragrance mentioned in The Volkhov Chronicles, one said to have been worn by Strivozha, the first Grand Duchess of the Vila.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: It's said that even His Majesty the Belyi Tsar was briefly captivated by her perfume, so much so that he called it "a fragrance surpassing all others across the icy plains"...

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: It's unfortunate, but even the Vila of our time — Miss Vesna of the Druzhna included — have no knowledge of such an ancient formula.

dialogues.speaker: Tyutcheva
dialogues.text: And so, I have no choice but to start from scratch. I'm experimenting with flowers from the northern continents, hoping to recreate that sense of airy, ethereal cold.
